Batch: 8 runs, all 8 accepted.
Flagged (1): r05, summary_outlier. Its largest flank difference has the opposite sign from the rest of the batch (-0.81 %/h, batch median 0.495, z -16). Its growth zone is also shorter (674 µm; every other root is 695 µm). All its final checks pass or were not run.
Cleared (7): r01, r02, r03, r04, r06, r07, r08. Their checks pass or were not run. Each centre-profile summary has |z| ≤ 1: REGR peak 53.15–53.27 %/h at 421 µm, growth zone 695 µm. The width-free runs give the same profiles as the constant-width runs. The -0.04 width-free ratio in r04 and r07 has a z of -1.99 only because the batch MAD is 0; it is the same size as the batch value of 0.04.
What the flagged run shows: r05 was measured with the width-free ratio, so plane sections was not run. Its centre strain-rate profile has a different shape from the rest of the batch: the flank difference has the opposite sign and the growth zone is shorter. The tip motion (closure) and rigid invariance still pass, so the checks did not catch this.
